title: Senior ticket price starts at 65
description: Bug report for the museum ticket price function: a visitor who is exactly 65 years old is charged the adult price, but the senior price applies from age 65 on. Fix the program. The complete rule is: a negative age is an error with the message "invalid age"; ages 0 to 4 pay 0; ages 5 to 17 pay 800; ages 18 to 64 pay 1500; ages 65 and older pay 1000. Prices are in cents.
notes: Bug: the adult-price test uses <= 65 instead of < 65. Only the age 65 boundary fails; every other band is already right.
